newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures rise on U.S. June PPI data.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures rise on U.S. June PPI data.

text.p: July 11 - Most U.S. debt futures rose on U.S. June producer price data. PPI was down 0.1 pct, vs estimates for steady and the core rate was up 0.1 pct, as expected. Sept T-bonds rose to 114-09/32, above resistance at 114-06/32. Key resistance is seen at an Elliott Wave target of 114-22/32.
